1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a __thermally conductive binder that is a thermally conductive epoxy__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __and the binder is thermally conductive epoxy__.

3. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.
